core_obligations: Right-to-left (proof lines 1219-1244): Diamond A lands in Gamma directly from Delta's inclusion of A and the definition of the Diamond-image of Delta - one line.

Left-to-right (lines 1267-1287): from Diamond A in Gamma, note Box not-A misses Gamma, deductive closure gives non-derivability, box2 and the consistency fact make the inverse image plus A consistent, Lindenbaum yields a complete Delta containing it; the tail paragraph verifies Diamond Delta is included in Gamma by a sub-contradiction: any B in Delta with Diamond B outside Gamma would force Box not-B into Gamma, hence not-B into the inverse image, breaking Delta's consistency.
